source_name: NBRM — Заштита на потрошувачи при договори за потрошувачки кредити
why_relevant: Consumer-credit protection page tied to the Law on Consumer Protection in Consumer Credit Agreements — the exact statute most often invoked in fee/APR disputes and in complaints escalated to the regulator.

source_name: Уставен суд на Република Северна Македонија — Одлуки и решенија (Constitutional Court decisions register)
why_relevant: Searchable, paginated register of У.бр. cases. Constitutional challenges to banking/payment-fee provisions and to supervisory powers are published in full with the contested article named and dated — the highest-signal legal source for provisions under stress.

source_name: Управен суд (Administrative Court, Skopje) — official portal on sud.mk
why_relevant: First-instance forum for disputes against administrative acts of supervisory bodies (NBRM, DPI, Ministry of Finance). Rulings show whether supervisory decisions on fee transparency and licensing survive judicial review.

source_name: Виш управен суд (Higher Administrative Court) — portal on sud.mk
why_relevant: Appellate instance over the Administrative Court; its 'ОДЛУКИ' module publishes decisions that settle contested supervisory/administrative interpretations, including in financial-sector matters.

source_name: Врховен суд на РСМ — Одлуки на судови / начелни ставови
why_relevant: Supreme Court decisions and, crucially, 'начелен став' (binding position of principle) documents that harmonise case law — e.g. positions on contract/fee disputes that immediately reshape how banks price and litigate.

source_name: Државен завод за ревизија (State Audit Office) — Ревизорски извештаи
why_relevant: Publishes regularity and performance audits of state bodies including the National Bank; audit findings name concrete weaknesses in supervisory and administrative practice and typically trigger remediation commitments with deadlines.

source_name: Државен завод за ревизија — NBRM regularity audit (worked example)
why_relevant: Confirms the State Audit Office does audit the central bank itself and publishes the report — establishes a recurring, enumerable series to track for findings about supervisory function and spending.

source_name: Народен правобранител (Ombudsman) — Годишни извештаи
why_relevant: Annual reports to Parliament document citizen grievances across sectors, including complaints touching financial services, account blocking, enforcement (извршување) and administrative failures by state bodies. Dated, quantified, and tabled in Parliament, so they carry policy weight.

source_name: Организација на потрошувачите на Македонија (ОПМ) — consumer organisation
why_relevant: The main national consumer NGO. It receives consumer complaints, routes financial-services complaints to NBRM / Ministry of Finance / Insurance Supervision Agency / State Market Inspectorate, and publishes guidance — an independent read on grievance volume and on which institution actually handles what.

source_name: ОПМ — Прирачник за финансиски услуги (consumer financial-services manual, 2025)
why_relevant: Recent NGO manual on consumer rights in financial services; useful as a glossary of the local complaint vocabulary and as evidence of which practices consumer advocates currently target.

source_name: Државен пазарен инспекторат (State Market Inspectorate, DPI)
why_relevant: Enforcement body for consumer-protection law and for misleading advertising of financial products (the piece of financial-services enforcement that sits outside NBRM). Its inspections and sanctions show where consumer rules bite in practice.

source_name: Министерство за економија и труд — Заштита на потрошувачи (Sector for Internal Market)
why_relevant: Policy owner for consumer protection: hosts the consumer-protection programme, the consumer council/advisory bodies, and the list of recognised consumer organisations — the authoritative actor map for the grievance side of the sector.

source_name: Регистар на организации на потрошувачи (NGO cooperation portal listing of consumer organisations)
why_relevant: Enumerates the regional consumer organisations (Bitola, Tetovo, Ohrid, Štip, etc.) beyond ОПМ — expands the actor map for grievance channels that surface locally before they reach the regulator.

source_name: Правдико — Судска пракса (legal portal case-law section)
why_relevant: Independent legal portal that summarises and republishes Macedonian and ECtHR case law in plain language. Far easier to monitor than the court portals and often flags banking/consumer-credit judgments the courts publish opaquely; use as a tripwire, then verify against the court source.

source_name: Провизии.мк — bank fee comparison portal
why_relevant: Comparative fee data across MK banks. Fee transparency portals are usually a regulatory-transparency obligation and are the factual baseline against which fee complaints and court challenges are argued; movement in listed fees is a measurable enforcement outcome.

source_name: Комисија за заштита на конкуренција (Commission for Protection of Competition)
why_relevant: Publishes decisions and concentration notifications involving banks (e.g. AIK Grup / Podravska Banka). Competition proceedings are a second enforcement track that can attack interchange/fee arrangements and reshape the payments market.

source_name: Академија за судии и јавни обвинители (JP Academy) — training materials on administrative disputes
why_relevant: Judicial-training materials explain how administrative disputes against regulators actually run (costs, standing, timelines) — background needed to interpret court output and to judge how likely supervisory decisions are to be challenged.

source_name: Council of Europe — analysis of inconsistent case law as a source of legal uncertainty (MK)
why_relevant: Documents the structural problem of inconsistent Macedonian case law — an important caveat for anyone treating a single judgment as settled law on bank fees, and a pointer to how harmonisation (начелни ставови) happens.

source_name: Karanović & Partners / Lexology — North Macedonia payment services legislation commentary
why_relevant: English-language law-firm commentary that flags changes in the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems — including fee transparency and comparability duties that later generate complaints and disputes. Useful bridge for non-mk readers and an early-warning channel on enforcement-relevant rule changes.

source_name: Закон за заштита на потрошувачите при договори за потрошувачки кредити (statute text, ОПМ-hosted copy)
why_relevant: Text of the consumer-credit statute that court and complaint decisions cite by article. Needed to map a judgment's cited provision to substance. Note: this is a third-party copy and may be superseded — the consolidated official text should be pulled from Службен весник / NBRM.

source_name: NBStat – National Bank of RNM Statistical Web Portal (PxWeb)
why_relevant: Machine-readable PxWeb time-series database of the central bank (External Statistics, Financial Accounts, Monetary and Interest Rates Statistics). PxWeb exposes a standard REST/JSON-stat API and .px table endpoints, making it the cheapest durable monitoring endpoint for recurring A3 runs; supervisory-reporting-derived aggregates appear here first in structured form.

source_name: NBRM – Statistics hub (Статистика)
why_relevant: Index page linking every statistical domain (monetary, interest rates, payments, external, financial accounts) plus release calendars and reporting instructions; the canonical map from which NBStat tables and Excel publications hang.

source_name: NBRM – Payment statistics (Платежна статистика)
why_relevant: Sector-specific payments dataset series (cards, terminals, transactions, payment instruments) published by the supervisor; the quantitative backbone for payments-sector A3 monitoring and for detecting new reporting obligations under the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems.

source_name: NBRM – Reporting for statistical purposes (Известувања за потребите на статистиката)
why_relevant: Publishes the reporting templates, instructions and submission deadlines imposed on banks and payment institutions — i.e. exactly the obligations-with-dates that A3 must catch, and the artefacts most often quietly re-versioned.

source_name: NBRM – consolidated law texts repository (/content/*.pdf)
why_relevant: NBRM hosts unofficial consolidated texts (неофицијален пречистен текст) of the core financial statutes under a flat /content/ path, with the gazette issue number embedded in the filename (e.g. '..._144-25.pdf'). That naming convention is a machine-readable signal of which Official Gazette issue last amended a law — a cheap change-detection trick for A3.
